title: Epimorphic projections from coherent formal-module limit sheaves
statement: Let Y be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and G a coherent J-adic formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For each n\ge0 the canonical projection lim G\to G_n (level n+1), with the limit taken among O_Y-module sheaves, is an epimorphism. No condition on another inverse system or morphism is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 087W and first half of Lemma 088B; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088B

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence of every level, by isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType. The defining quotient isomorphism writes each successor transition as formalModuleQuotientπ followed by an isomorphism; the quotient projection is a cokernel projection and therefore epic.

Apply quasiCoherent_cokernel_image to a transition φ. Since φ is epic, cancel φ in φ≫cokernel.π φ=0 to obtain cokernel.π φ=0. On an affine open the cited formula says ker(cokernel.π φ)=range φ; its left side is all sections, so the transition is surjective on affine sections.

Evaluate the limit cone on an affine open. Evaluation preserves limits of module sheaves. The tail functor k↦n+k is final, because every k is at most n+k, and its opposite is initial. Restrict the evaluated limit cone to this tail. Mathlib Concrete.surjective_π_app_zero_of_surjective_map applies to its surjective successor maps and gives surjectivity of the original nth projection. Thus the limit sheaf projection is surjective on every affine open.

The target level is quasi-coherent by the first step. All affine opens cover Y, by Mathlib iSup_affineOpens_eq_top. Apply the existing epi_of_surjective_app theorem to this cover and the established sectionwise surjectivity. This proves the sheaf projection epic without finite completed-module reconstruction or formal functions.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_limit_projection_epi {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (n : ℕ) :
    Epi (limit.π G.obj (op n))
